name: catalogue-review
title: Catalogue review worksheet
for_each: select id,code from catalogues order by code

sections.title: Source records
sections.sql: select object_id,name,category,available,status,reviewed_on,expires_on from records where catalogue_id=$1 order by object_id

sections.title: Expected search results
sections.sql: select query,expected_object_id,max_rank,rationale from relevance_cases where catalogue_id=$1 order by query

name: synonym-review
title: Synonym review worksheet
for_each: select id,code from catalogues order by code

sections.title: Vocabulary to check
sections.sql: select term,expansion,owner,review_on from synonyms where catalogue_id=$1 order by term

sections.title: Open work
sections.sql: select title,owner,due_on from tasks where catalogue_id=$1 and status='open' order by due_on

name: retention-review
title: Search history retention review
for_each: select id,code from catalogues order by code

sections.title: Local retention policy
sections.sql: select name,owner,purpose,retention_days from catalogues where id=$1

sections.title: Events past the chosen period
sections.sql: select occurred_on,count(*)::int as event_count from query_events where catalogue_id=$1 and occurred_on<current_date-(select retention_days from catalogues where id=$1) group by occurred_on order by occurred_on
sections.note: The operator reviews retention and arranges approved removal. This report is not a legal certification.
